policy.title: Policy before side effects
policy.text: Every tool declares risk and crosses a centralized policy decision before changing files, launching processes or reaching the network.

filesystem.title: Bounded filesystem
filesystem.text: Canonical path validation and deny rules keep mutations inside explicitly allowed roots.

secrets.title: Secret hygiene
secrets.text: Credential references are stored separately with restrictive permissions; logs and UI surfaces redact sensitive values.

process.title: Process containment
process.text: No-shell execution by default, timeouts and process-group cancellation prevent orphan workloads.

audit.title: Auditable history
audit.text: Mission and session events retain identity, causality, inputs, outputs and cryptographic integrity links.

access.title: Controlled access
access.text: The web control plane uses rotating bearer tokens, role-aware sessions and explicit six-digit device pairing.

extensions.title: Signed extensions
extensions.text: Ed25519 manifests bind publisher trust, exact source hashes, runtime compatibility, permissions and declared capabilities before code import.

hooks.title: Contained hooks
hooks.text: Runtime hooks receive redacted events through timeout, retry, circuit-breaker and dead-letter boundaries; malformed output cannot stop a mission.

automation.title: Signed automation
automation.text: Webhook secrets remain references; constant-time HMAC verification, idempotency keys, expiring leases, bounded retries and hash-linked audit records contain autonomous scheduling.

sandbox.title: Native containment
sandbox.text: Workspace and isolated profiles use platform-native process, mount and network boundaries; required mode fails closed when its backend is unavailable.

acp.title: Bounded ACP
acp.text: ACP sessions use strict JSON-RPC schemas, project-scoped working directories, atomic private metadata, concurrent cancellation and a five-minute request ceiling.

messaging.title: Contained messaging
messaging.text: Inbound deliveries are deduplicated and redacted before persistence; integrity checks, leases, bounded retries and a transactional outbox contain channel failures.

threat.title: Assume output can be wrong.
threat.lead: Model text, tool arguments, external pages and subprocess output are untrusted. Typed validation and permission boundaries contain malformed or adversarial output before it becomes a side effect.

reporting.title: Found a vulnerability?
reporting.lead: Please use private vulnerability reporting rather than a public issue. Include reproduction details, affected versions and potential impact.
reporting.cardText: Our disclosure process, supported versions and response expectations live with the source.
